shared_elements: bearded human figure in profile with elaborately curled/patterned hair
low-relief figures oriented in a single direction
stylized tree/plant with dense repeated foliage rendered as rows of incised units
garment with patterned hem or fringe
horned animal head in profile (rams in A; horned headdress in B)
justification: Both surfaces show profile bearded figures in shallow relief beside a densely patterned stylized tree, with rosette/floral elements and identical conventions for rendering hair, fleece and foliage as rows of repeated incised curls or scales. The decisive difference is the subject: A is a mundane procession of men driving horned rams along a frieze with a floral band beneath, while B is a single winged, horned-capped supernatural figure gesturing toward an ornate palmette-and-rosette plant.
